title: Kiểm tra tuần 9: Chiến lược Listening & Writing Task 1
passage:
Commuting Patterns in Westbridge, 2010–2020

A recent report by the Westbridge transport authority examined how residents travelled to work over a ten-year period. The figures reveal a clear shift away from private cars, although the change was neither steady nor evenly distributed across the city.

In 2010, almost 60 per cent of commuters drove to work, while buses accounted for around a quarter of journeys. Cycling was a minor option, chosen by just 5 per cent of workers. Over the following decade, car use fell gradually to 48 per cent. The most dramatic change, however, was in cycling, which tripled to 15 per cent by 2020. Much of this growth occurred after 2016, when the city opened a network of protected cycle lanes linking the suburbs to the business district.

Bus travel followed a different pattern. Its share rose slightly in the first half of the decade, peaking at 28 per cent in 2014, before declining to 22 per cent by the end of the period. The authors suggest that rising fares and the reduction of night services may have encouraged some passengers to switch to bicycles. Walking, meanwhile, remained stable at roughly 10 per cent throughout.

The report also notes significant differences between districts. In the city centre, fewer than one in three commuters used a car by 2020, whereas in outer areas with limited public transport, driving remained the dominant choice. The authors conclude that investment in infrastructure, rather than public awareness campaigns, was the main driver of change, and they recommend extending the cycle network to the outer districts before 2030.

questions.q: Before the Listening audio starts, you read this gap: "The museum opens at ______ on Sundays." What type of answer should you predict?
options: A verb in the past tense
questions.explain: Sau "opens at" và trước "on Sundays" thường là giờ giấc. Đoán trước loại từ giúp bạn nghe đúng thông tin cần điền.

questions.q: In the Listening test you hear: "The meeting was going to be on Tuesday, but it's now been moved to Thursday." Question: "The meeting will take place on ______." What is the correct answer?
questions.explain: "Tuesday" là bẫy vì thông tin đã bị thay đổi; từ "but" báo hiệu đáp án thật là Thursday.

questions.q: A line graph shows the number of visitors to three museums from 2000 to 2020. Which sentence is an OVERVIEW (not an introduction or a detail)?
options: In 2000, Museum A had exactly 20,000 visitors.
The graph shows the number of visitors to three museums from 2000 to 2020.
In my opinion, museums are very important for education.
Overall, visitor numbers to all three museums increased, and Museum A remained the most popular throughout the period.
questions.explain: Overview nêu xu hướng chính và đặc điểm nổi bật, không đưa số liệu chi tiết. Câu B chỉ là câu mở bài (paraphrase đề), câu C là ý kiến cá nhân, không được dùng trong Task 1.

questions.q: Monthly sales went from 100 units in January to 102 units in December. Which phrase describes this change accurately?
questions.explain: Tăng từ 100 lên 102 là mức tăng rất nhỏ nên dùng "increased slightly". "Dramatically" là tăng mạnh, "plummeted" là giảm mạnh.

questions.q: A table shows that 45% of people in Country X recycle, compared with 15% in Country Y. Which sentence is accurate?
options: The figure for Country X was twice as high as that for Country Y.
Country Y had a higher recycling rate than Country X.
The figure for Country X was three times as high as that for Country Y.
The recycling rate in Country X was a third of that in Country Y.
questions.explain: 45% gấp 3 lần 15%, nên dùng "three times as high as". Khi so sánh trong bảng/biểu đồ cột cần tính đúng tỉ lệ.

questions.q: A pie chart shows that a family spends 26% of its budget on housing. Which phrase correctly expresses 26%?
questions.explain: Một phần tư là 25%, nên 26% là "just over a quarter" (hơn một phần tư một chút).

questions.q: When describing a process diagram (e.g. how coffee is produced), which grammar is used most often?
options: The present simple passive (e.g. "The beans are roasted.")
The past continuous (e.g. "The beans were being roasted.")
The future perfect (e.g. "The beans will have been roasted.")
The first person (e.g. "I roast the beans.")
questions.explain: Quy trình mô tả các bước lặp lại và tập trung vào hành động, nên dùng bị động thì hiện tại đơn.

questions.q: Two maps show a village in 1990 and 2020. In 1990 there was a forest in the north; in 2020 a housing estate stands in the same place. Which sentence describes this change correctly?
options: A housing estate was demolished to make way for a forest in the north.
The forest in the north was built in 2020.
The forest in the north was cleared to make way for a housing estate.
The housing estate in the north was moved to the south.
questions.explain: Rừng bị chặt (cleared) để nhường chỗ (make way for) cho khu nhà ở. Câu A đảo ngược thứ tự thay đổi.

questions.q: Choose the correct word form: "There was a ______ rise in the number of tourists in 2019."
questions.explain: Trước danh từ "rise" cần tính từ: "a sharp rise". "Sharply" là trạng từ, đi với động từ (rose sharply).

questions.q: "Unemployment peaked at 12% in 2009." What does "peaked at" mean?
options: fell to its lowest point at
questions.explain: "Peak at" nghĩa là đạt mức cao nhất. Mức thấp nhất là "hit a low of" hoặc "bottomed out at".

questions.q: "The price of rice ______ between 20,000 and 25,000 dong, going up and down several times during the year." Choose the best verb.
questions.explain: "Fluctuate" nghĩa là dao động, lên xuống liên tục, đúng với "going up and down several times".

questions.q: The number of cars in a town fell from 200 to 100. Which verb describes this change?
questions.explain: Giảm từ 200 xuống 100 là giảm một nửa: "halved". "Doubled" là tăng gấp đôi.

questions.q: True, False or Not Given? "The share of commuters travelling by bus was higher in 2020 than in 2010."
questions.explain: Năm 2010 xe buýt chiếm khoảng 25%, năm 2020 chỉ còn 22%, nên câu này mâu thuẫn với bài: False.

questions.q: Which heading best fits the third paragraph (beginning "Bus travel followed a different pattern")?
options: The rise and fall of bus travel
New cycle lanes in the suburbs
questions.explain: Đoạn 3 mô tả xe buýt tăng nhẹ, đạt đỉnh năm 2014 rồi giảm. Việc đi bộ chỉ được nhắc là ổn định, không trở nên phổ biến hơn.

questions.q: According to the authors of the report, what was the main reason for the change in commuting habits?
options: A fall in the number of jobs in the city centre
questions.explain: Bài viết nói rõ "investment in infrastructure, rather than public awareness campaigns, was the main driver of change".
